explanation: The new name means 'land of the free'. Thailand was the only Southeast Asian country never colonized by a European power, and Siamese cats keep the old name.

claims.text: Siam changed its name to Thailand in 1939.
Myanmar, Cambodia and Laos were never called Siam.
The name Thailand is usually translated as 'land of the free'.
Thailand is the only Southeast Asian country that was never colonized by a European power.
Siamese cats are named after Siam.
